item.text:
**Bottom Line**  
The 2024 record is mostly negative: Hasina personally used highly charged scapegoating language against student protesters and then blamed political opponents and the U.S. for the crisis. I found only weak counterevidence: post-hoc claims of resigning to avoid more bloodshed and a later call for investigations.

- [Explainer-Why are Bangladesh students protesting against job quotas?](https://theprint.in/world/explainer-why-are-bangladesh-students-protesting-against-job-quotas/2179678/) — Reuters, July 18, 2024. Claim: Reuters says Hasina called quota protesters “razakar” and that the slur helped inflame the movement; this is direct hostile labeling of domestic opponents and fits 3B.3. IDs: `3B.3`, `2B.6`
- [Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-calm-a-day-after-top-court-scrapped-some-job-quotas-3528153) — Reuters, July 22, 2024. Claim: Hasina publicly blamed political opponents for deadly violence during the protests, reinforcing a scapegoating frame rather than de-escalation. IDs: `3B.3`, `2B.6`
- [Sheikh Hasina alleges US role in ouster, says could've remained in power if she surrendered sovereignty of Saint Martin Island](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/team-hasina-hints-at-us-role-in-ouster/articleshow/112432625.cms?from=mdr) — The Economic Times, August 11, 2024. Claim: Hasina accused the U.S. of orchestrating her ouster over St. Martin’s Island and told supporters not to be manipulated by radicals; this is conspiratorial scapegoating language, not a peaceable or restrained message. IDs: `3B.3`, `2B.6`
- [Former Bangladesh PM Hasina demands probe into July "killings and vandalism"](https://theprint.in/world/former-bangladesh-pm-hasina-demands-probe-into-july-killings-and-vandalism/2222256/) — Reuters, August 13, 2024. Claim: After fleeing, Hasina called for investigation and punishment of those involved in “killings and vandalism”; this is the closest counterevidence, but it is post-hoc and does not show she avoided inciting or escalating during the crisis. IDs: `3B.3`, `2B.9`

**Search Gap**  
I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Hasina personally incited violence against minorities, journalists, civil society, or other named protected groups. The clearest direct material is instead about hostile framing of student protesters and political opponents, plus later scapegoating of the U.S. and “radicals.”
